atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.

atoms.name: swap
atoms.rule: a v1_u2928_ b swaps cards at positions b / 5 and b % 5, counting from zero; an invalid position gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2928_ b swaps cards at positions b / 5 and b % 5, counting from zero; an invalid position gives NaN.

atoms.name: rotate_left
atoms.rule: a v1_u293A_ moves every card one position left, wrapping the first position to the last.
atoms.plain: a v1_u293A_ moves every card one position left, wrapping the first position to the last.

atoms.name: rotate_right
atoms.rule: a v1_u21B7_ moves every card one position right, wrapping the last position to the first.
atoms.plain: a v1_u21B7_ moves every card one position right, wrapping the last position to the first.

atoms.name: perm_reverse
atoms.rule: a v1_u2940_ reverses the positions of all cards.
atoms.plain: a v1_u2940_ reverses the positions of all cards.

atoms.name: perm_compose
atoms.rule: a v1_u2218_ b moves each card by a first and then by b; the result at card i is b[a[i]].
atoms.plain: a v1_u2218_ b moves each card by a first and then by b; the result at card i is b[a[i]].

atoms.name: perm_inverse
atoms.rule: a v1_u293E_ sends each card back to its original position; its value at i is the card at position i in a.
atoms.plain: a v1_u293E_ sends each card back to its original position; its value at i is the card at position i in a.

atoms.name: perm_apply
atoms.rule: a v1_u25CE_ b is the final position of card b under a; an invalid card number gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a v1_u25CE_ b is the final position of card b under a; an invalid card number gives NaN.

atoms.name: perm_equal
atoms.rule: a v1_u224B_ b is true exactly when both permutations send every card to the same position.
atoms.plain: a v1_u224B_ b is true exactly when both permutations send every card to the same position.

domain.en: A value is an arrangement of five cards. The list gives, for each card, the position it moves to.
Integers choose positions and count recursive steps.

settings.en: The number of cards; register_perm(n) accepts 2 to 26.
A recursive call repeats its card move at most this many times; larger counts give NaN.

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.

operators.name: f1
operators.plain: Rotate a one place right, then reverse its order.

operators.name: f2
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 0, 2, 3, 4], apply f20 to a and b, then invert it; otherwise compute a f20 b.

operators.name: f3
operators.definition: a f3 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f3 (b - 1)) v1_u293A_, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a f3 (b + 1)) v1_u293A_, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): rotate the current value one place left.

operators.name: f4
operators.plain: Rotate a one place right, then swap the cards at positions 0 and 4 in the result.

operators.name: f5
operators.plain: Swap cards in [2, 3, 4, 0, 1] using a f8 as a position code.

operators.name: f6
operators.plain: Test whether [2, 3, 4, 0, 1] equals a with cards swapped using b as a position code.

operators.name: f7
operators.plain: Rotate a one place right, then apply f6 to the result and 0.

operators.name: f8
operators.plain: Rotate a one place right, then find where card 1 goes under it.

operators.name: f9
operators.plain: Invert a, then find where card 0 goes under it.

operators.name: f10
operators.plain: Find where card a f9 goes under [3, 2, 4, 0, 1].

operators.name: f11
operators.plain: Rotate a one place right, then apply f10 to the result.

operators.name: f12
operators.plain: Swap cards in a using b as a position code, then apply f9 to the result.

operators.name: f13
operators.plain: Find where card b goes under a, then add 3 to it.

operators.name: f14
operators.plain: Add a f11 to 3.

operators.name: f15
operators.plain: Find where card a f14 goes under [1, 2, 4, 3, 0].

operators.name: f16
operators.plain: Swap cards in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] using the position of card b under a as a position code.

operators.name: f17
operators.plain: Apply f9 to a, then apply f12 to [2, 4, 0, 3, 1] and the result.

operators.name: f18
operators.plain: Follow [4, 1, 2, 0, 3] with a f1.

operators.name: f19
operators.plain: If a equals [0, 1, 3, 2, 4], rotate a one place right, then apply f4 to the result; otherwise rotate a one place right.

operators.name: f20
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 2, 3, 0, 4], follow a with b, then apply f4 to the result; otherwise follow a with b.

operators.name: f21
operators.plain: If a equals [4, 2, 3, 1, 0], swap cards in a using b as a position code, then reverse its order; otherwise swap cards in a using b as a position code.

operators.name: f22
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 4, 3, 0, 1], follow [4, 1, 3, 2, 0] with the inverse of a; otherwise invert a.

operators.name: f23
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 3, 4, 0, 2], follow [4, 2, 1, 3, 0] with a with positions reversed; otherwise reverse the order of a.

operators.name: f24
operators.plain: If a equals [2, 0, 1, 3, 4], rotate a one place left, then apply f1 to the result; otherwise rotate a one place left.

operators.name: f25
operators.plain: If a equals [4, 3, 2, 1, 0], follow [2, 3, 0, 1, 4] with a rotated one place right; otherwise rotate a one place right.

operators.name: f26
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 2, 3, 4, 0], apply f19 to a, then apply f24 to the result; otherwise apply f19 to a.

operators.name: f27
operators.plain: If a equals [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], follow a with b, then rotate it one place right; otherwise follow a with b.

operators.name: f28
operators.definition: a f28 b = { - (a v1_u25CE_ b), if a v1_u224B_ P[4, 1, 0, 2, 3]; a v1_u25CE_ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [4, 1, 0, 2, 3], find where card b goes under a, then negate it; otherwise find where card b goes under a.

operators.name: f29
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 2, 3, 4, 0], apply f24 to a, then apply f18 to the result; otherwise apply f24 to a.

operators.name: f30
operators.plain: Apply f16 to a and b, then follow it with [0, 3, 2, 1, 4].

operators.name: f31
operators.plain: Apply f10 to a, then apply f13 to [1, 2, 4, 3, 0] and the result.

operators.name: f32
operators.plain: Subtract a f13 b from 4.

operators.name: f33
operators.plain: If a equals [4, 3, 2, 1, 0], apply f28 to a and b, then add 4 to it; otherwise compute a f28 b.

operators.name: f34
operators.plain: Apply f24 to a, then apply f22 to the result.

operators.name: f35
operators.definition: a f35 b = { 2 + (a v1_u25CE_ b), if a v1_u224B_ P[1, 0, 2, 3, 4]; a v1_u25CE_ b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 0, 2, 3, 4], add the position of card b under a to 2; otherwise find where card b goes under a.

operators.name: f36
operators.plain: Apply f13 to (a rotated one place right) and 1.

operators.name: f37
operators.plain: Apply f10 to a, then apply f32 to [2, 0, 4, 3, 1] and the result.

operators.name: f38
operators.plain: Apply f25 to a, then rotate it one place left.

operators.name: f39
operators.plain: If a equals [4, 3, 2, 1, 0], apply f16 to a and b, then apply f5 to the result; otherwise compute a f16 b.

operators.name: f40
operators.plain: If a equals [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], apply f35 to a and b, then apply f33 to [2, 1, 4, 3, 0] and the result; otherwise compute a f35 b.

operators.name: f41
operators.plain: Apply f32 to a and b, then subtract 2 from it.

operators.name: f42
operators.definition: a f42 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f42 (b - 1)) f1, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a f42 (b + 1)) f1, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply f1 to the current value.

operators.name: f43
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply f26 to the current value.

operators.name: f44
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply f23 to the current value.

operators.name: f45

operators.name: f46

operators.name: f47
operators.definition: a f47 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f47 (b - 1)) f4, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a f47 (b + 1)) f4, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply f4 to the current value.

operators.name: f49

operators.name: f50
operators.definition: a f50 b = { a, if b == 0; (a f50 (b - 1)) f5, if b > 0 and b <= 3; (a f50 (b + 1)) f5, if b < 0 and b >= - 3 }
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b| times (for b from -3 to 3; other values give NaN): apply f5 to the current value.

operators.name: f51
operators.definition: a f51 b = { (a f3 b) f15 }
operators.plain: Apply f3 to a and b, then apply f15 to the result.

operators.name: f52
operators.definition: a f52 b = { (a f47 b) f1 }
operators.plain: Apply f47 to a and b, then apply f1 to the result.

operators.name: f53
operators.plain: Apply f3 to a and b, then apply f2 to the result and [2, 4, 1, 0, 3].

operators.name: f54
operators.plain: Apply f35 to (a f3 b) and 0.

operators.name: f55
operators.plain: Apply f47 to a and b, then rotate it one place right.

operators.name: f56
operators.plain: Apply f43 to a and b, then apply f2 to the result and [0, 4, 2, 3, 1].

operators.name: f57
operators.plain: Apply f42 to a and b, then apply f19 to the result.

operators.name: f58
operators.plain: Apply f51 to (a f53 b) and 0.

operators.name: f59
operators.plain: Apply f48 to a and b, then test whether the result equals [2, 0, 4, 3, 1].

operators.name: f60

operators.name: f61

operators.name: f62

operators.name: f63

operators.name: f66
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 0, 2, 3, 4], apply f63 to a and b, then apply f12 to [2, 0, 4, 3, 1] and the result; otherwise compute a f63 b.

operators.name: f67
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 0, 2, 3, 4], apply f51 to a and b, then apply f66 to [2, 1, 3, 4, 0] and the result; otherwise compute a f51 b.

operators.name: f68

operators.name: f69
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 2, 3, 4, 0], apply f54 to a and b, then subtract 2 from it; otherwise compute a f54 b.

operators.plain: If a equals [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], apply f66 to a and b, then apply f51 to [3, 0, 1, 4, 2] and the result; otherwise compute a f66 b.

operators.definition: a f74 b = { (a f3 b) f24, if a v1_u224B_ P[1, 0, 2, 3, 4]; a f3 b, else }
operators.plain: If a equals [1, 0, 2, 3, 4], apply f3 to a and b, then apply f24 to the result; otherwise compute a f3 b.

operators.name: f75
